brief:
An Israeli official rejected claims of an attempted assassination plot targeting Yair Netanyahu, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's son, according to the Ma'an news agency. The official characterized the allegations as hallucinations, offering no substantive engagement with the specifics of the purported threat.

The dismissal follows reports circulating about a supposed threat against Netanyahu's son. The source of the original allegations and the precise nature of the claimed plot remain unclear from available reporting. It was not immediately evident whether Israeli security services had investigated the matter or what prompted the official's public statement.
title: Israeli official dismisses attempted assassination plot against Yair Netanyahu as hallucinations
